name: Tomb of the Golden Relic
detailed_description:
Enter the depths of an ancient, labyrinthine tomb where every shadow hides a secret—and a lurking danger. In this tense, atmospheric puzzle-adventure, you step into the boots of an explorer searching for a legendary artifact. But the deeper you venture, the more you realize you are not alone.

Navigate a maze filled with environmental puzzles, hidden passages, and the remnants of past explorers who left behind cryptic notes and desperate warnings. At first, you are free to explore, piecing together clues, uncovering lost history, and activating ancient mechanisms. But once you claim what appears to be the treasure, everything changes. The mummy awakens, and the chase begins.

Now, survival is your priority. Outsmart your relentless pursuer, use throwable objects like pots to slow it down, and avoid being trapped in the twisting corridors of the tomb. Every decision matters—will you take the safest route to escape, or risk everything to uncover the tomb’s deepest secret?

Key Features:

  • A Living Tomb – Solve intricate environmental puzzles, uncover hidden pathways, and interact with ancient mechanisms to progress.

  • A Relentless Mummy – Once awakened, the mummy will stop at nothing to hunt you down. Stay one step ahead, or risk becoming its next victim.

  • Multiple Endings – Your fate depends on your choices. Will you escape with the fake artifact, uncover the real treasure, or disappear into legend?

  • Immersive Atmosphere – Feel the weight of history through detailed environments, eerie sound design, and explorer notes that reveal the tragic fates of those who came before you.

  • Dynamic Challenge – The game evolves from a methodical puzzle-solving experience into a heart-pounding survival challenge, forcing you to adapt on the fly.

The tomb is waiting. The artifact calls to you. But once you take it, will you make it out alive?

short_description: The game set in an ancient labyrinth with a mummy. Players take on the role of an adventurer searching for a lost golden artifact, but uncovering it triggers the mummy’s pursuit. Along the way, they must decide whether to escape with the real artifact, a fake, or leave empty-handed.
